content: (MAC Source Address, StationId in CAM/DENM, GN Source Address) shall be derive d from the "Certificate digest" / "hashedId8". The required number of least significant bytes of the "Certificate digest" / "hashedId8" shall be used as respective identifier. ⌋ ( SRS_V2X_00010 ) [SWS_V2xM_00005] The V2xM module shall provide a mechanism to permit V2X modules to inhibit the identity change for a duration of maximum 15 minutes (e.g. during DENM event) via an API call to V2xM_LockPseudonymChange .
